customThemeDesc: We design and hand-code a theme around your brand instead of adapting a marketplace template. That means faster load times, no unused CSS or JavaScript from bloated page-builder plugins, and full control over how every page looks and behaves.
woocommerceDesc: A complete WooCommerce build covering product catalog structure, payment gateway integration, shipping and tax rules, and inventory management, configured for your specific product range and built to stay fast at checkout under real traffic.
pluginDevDesc: When an off-the-shelf plugin doesn't do exactly what your business needs, we write a custom one instead of stacking three plugins that half-solve the problem. Fewer, purpose-built plugins mean a smaller attack surface and better performance.
responsiveDesc: Every theme we build is tested across breakpoints on real devices, not just a browser resize, because a WordPress site that isn't genuinely mobile-first loses both search rankings and conversions on the majority of your traffic.
introText: WordPress powers over 40% of all websites worldwide, but a generic theme and a handful of plugins rarely deliver the performance, security, or brand fit a growing business needs. We build WordPress and WooCommerce sites the way we'd want ours built: hand-coded themes instead of bloated page builders, a deliberately lean plugin stack, and a Core Web Vitals budget we design against from day one. Whether you're launching a content site, a company website, or a full WooCommerce store, the goal is a site that's fast, secure, and easy for your team to manage long after we hand it over.
process1Desc: We map your content structure, product catalog (for WooCommerce), and growth plans, then define the theme architecture and plugin stack before writing any code.
process2Desc: Custom theme development, WooCommerce configuration, and any custom plugin work happen in a staging environment, with Core Web Vitals checked at every milestone, not just before launch.
process3Desc: We test every page, form, and checkout flow across devices and browsers, then handle hosting cutover and 301 redirect mapping if you're migrating an existing site.
process4Desc: Post-launch, we monitor uptime and performance, with ongoing maintenance plans covering core, theme, and plugin updates, security scanning, and backups.
rightForTitle: Is WordPress Right for Your Business?
rightForText: WordPress is the right choice if you need a content-heavy site your team can update without a developer, a WooCommerce store with standard e-commerce needs, or a fast launch on a defined budget. If you need a highly custom web application, real-time features, or performance beyond what a CMS architecture allows, our custom web development service is usually the better fit — we'll help you figure out which one during a free consultation.

faq.q1: Should I choose WordPress or a custom-coded website?
faq.a1: WordPress is faster and cheaper to launch with a flexible CMS for content-heavy sites. If you need a highly custom application or maximum performance, our custom web development service may be a better fit — we'll help you decide during the consultation.
faq.q2: Can you migrate my existing WooCommerce store without downtime?
faq.a2: Yes. We stage the new store, test payments and inventory sync fully, then cut over during a low-traffic window with 301 redirects mapped for every product and category URL.
faq.q3: Do you build custom themes or use page builders?
faq.a3: We hand-code custom themes for performance and full design control, rather than relying on bloated page-builder plugins that slow down Core Web Vitals scores.
faq.q4: What ongoing WordPress maintenance do I need?
faq.a4: Core, theme, and plugin updates, security scanning, and backups. We offer a dedicated Website Maintenance plan if you'd rather not manage this yourself.
